title: Ascended Arts
description: Addon for Epic Fight with slight wuxia/xianxia theme.
body:
Addon for Epic Fight with slight wuxia/xianxia theme. 

I like how Epic Fight plays, and wanted to make something of my own. Also contains some concepts from a book I'm working on that may eventually be posted somewhere. I hope you enjoy it!

**CURRENTLY INCLUDED**

Weapons: Jian (similar to a sword) with tiers of Wood, Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite, and Unique , Large Scythe, and smaller scythes with tiers of Wood, Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite

Armor: a set of "hanfu armor" from armorless, iron, gold, diamond, and netherite. Made with (added) cloth for the base unarmored and a simple smithing upgrade with the base vanilla armors. Hanfu armors provide extra durability and enchantability compared to the base armors. 

Armors also come in a base white, but can be dyed with any dye. 

Also, all armors can be trimmed with a modified "hanfu trim" I did my best to replicate the standard armor trims but with the increased texture resolution of the 3D armor.  (Trimming results will not work properly with vanilla trims are used on Hanfu armor due to texture size difference) 

Two Unique armors are also added [Void Slayer] and [Royal Hunter] both mementos from my personal work. Slightly stronger than Netherite. They also can be dyed and trimmed appropriately with the Hanfu Trims. 

Some additional Emotes 1.21.1 silly stuff

**COMPATABILITY**

Added slight compatability with Supplementaries and Corail Tombstone (until I get something to work similar to how maps and spyglasses are done, they have their own "weapon style") with the flute and anhk.
Just different ways to hold the items instead of normal with simple attacks.
something additional testing is needed for 1.21.1 apparently

Malum: gave the crude and soulsteel scythe the "small scythe" weapon style since a normal sword doesn't quite fit the sweeping strike it has. Also made the armor compatible, but I don't think EF works with the cosmetic system in Malum, so can't really make the weaves "compatible" sorry :(

Dye The World armor colors for the dyes (texture issues from how the dyeing was implemented)
